quote: The oil and natural gas industry is intensely competitive, and we compete with other companies that have greater resources.
why: 石油・ガス生産で「intensely competitive」の一般的な競争記述のみ。顧客の乗り換え費用の機構は名指しなし

quote: Revenue and profit growth from the ISS supplies business is directly linked to the ability to increase the installed base of ISS laser products or the usage rate of those products.
why: 「supplies business」が「installed base」に直結と断定＝設置基盤を名指し。互換品も競合し再認定の話はない

quote: Our sales are dependent upon clients’ initial decisions to replace or substantially modify their existing information systems, and subsequently, their decision concerning which products and services to purchase.
why: 「decisions to replace」は当社が置き換えを取る側の販売の話。データ移行等の機構の名指しなし

quote: Glaucoma must be treated over an extended period and doctors may be reluctant to switch a patient to a new treatment if the patient's current treatment for glaucoma is effective and well tolerated.
why: 「may be reluctant to switch」は推量で、新製品普及の障害の文脈。規約の摩擦機構の名指しなし

quote: Customers generally continue to use the chosen energy source for the life of the equipment.
why: 「for the life of the equipment」と据え付けた設備が選択を固定すると断定＝設置基盤。再認定の話なし

quote: Our customers consider many factors when choosing suppliers, including product reliability, clinical outcomes, product availability, inventory consignment, price and product services provided by the manufacturer.
why: 「choosing suppliers」を価格・供給等で決める一般的な競争記述。乗り換え費用の機構なし

quote: We compete on the basis of product quality, brand image, innovation, price, and service in response to consumer preferences.
why: 「compete on the basis of product quality, brand image」等の一般的な競争記述のみ

quote: Some of the capacity from our existing portfolio is sold under long-term PPAs that expire at various times.
why: 「long-term PPAs」で複数年の購買義務を名指し。ただし「Some of the capacity」に限られ確信は低い

quote: Our transmission and distribution business is minimally impacted when customers choose alternate electric or gas suppliers since we earn our return by providing transmission and distribution service, not by supplying the commodity.
why: 「customers choose alternate electric or gas suppliers」と乗り換え自由が前提。機構の名指しなし

quote: Because our technologies and fonts are embedded in the hardware of our customers’ CE devices, it would be costly and time-consuming to replace these solutions.
why: 「embedded in the hardware」ゆえ置換は「costly and time-consuming」と顧客負担を断定。再試験の明示なし

quote: Mutual fund investors may redeem their investments in our mutual funds at any time without any prior notice.
why: 「redeem ... at any time without any prior notice」と顧客は自由に解約でき、損をするのは当社

quote: Customers moving from entry-level designs to those requiring real-time emulation are able to preserve their investment in learning and tools as they migrate to future PIC devices since all of our PIC and dsPIC development tools share the same integrated development environment.
why: 顧客の「investment in learning and tools」が同じ開発環境で保たれると断定＝再教育の機構を名指し
